title: 22 小贺村入v公告23 李术师
slug: 在诡异世界变成蜘蛛精
content_zh:
：商谈完，两个人都达成了目的。
商队管事得到了一些内部消息，心满意足。
贺堪得到了一个商队以后经常前来小贺村的约定，同样心满意足，这样子，村里就不用那样窘迫了。
商队管事与贺堪相互对视一笑，各自都有默契。
即使发生了刚刚诡物袭击的事情，商队也没有动身的打算，他们只是将篝火又多加了几个，轮勤的人更多，值夜的人也更多，贺堪明白商队为什么不动身离开，还是那句话，夜晚是诡物的世界，动身寻找新的营地，很可能损失更多，还不如待在原地。
贺堪选择值上半夜。
一夜好眠。
可能是树鬼卵的留下的气息，也可能是诡物之间有着大家都不清楚的交流方式，总而言之，这一夜什么都没有发生。
第二天。
贺堪早早的起来了。
一大早，商队伙夫就将洗漱用品都准备好，烧的热水温度也刚刚好，在有些凉意的早上，这样有点温度的热水，整个人都舒展开了，更不用说洗漱完成之后，商队伙夫恰到好处送上的热腾腾的粥米。
贺堪吃下去更舒服。
今天这么早当然还有一件事情。
贺堪快要与商队分别了。
小贺村在大启城的西边，商队接下来的商道则是在南边，不止不同行，商队跟着走了，很可能还要绕路，这是早在大启城就达成的共识，在官道结束的时候，贺堪与商队分开。
即使因为昨天诡物袭击事件导致商队管事有些意动，却也没有提出改变路线的意思，这个世界，小心谨慎已经刻进所有人的心里，一件事情不是你想怎样就怎样，负担的是更多人的性命。
只能说，商队以后更愿意将小贺村纳入商道当中。
这就够了。
贺堪十分利索的准备分道扬镳。
他一共买了差不多500斤的粮食，再加上衣物与各色用品，差不多600斤，贺堪算的十分准，他可以拎100斤左右，因为防止路途中遇到的诡物，他只能提很少的一部分，剩下的都可以用驴车来驮。

是的。
考虑到粮食的问题。
贺堪一开始是租的，直到刚刚才发现，与其租不如直接花钱，贺堪就花钱与商队将这只驴车买了下来，驮粮食也都很方便。
“那贺大人了，在下就告辞了。”
早上都收拾完毕，贺堪也将驴车收拾出来，粮食就在拉车上面，堆的是满满当当，一开始，商队管事并不想要银子，说是感谢昨天的出手，贺堪却觉得一码归一码，硬是将银子给了。
贺堪单身一人，驴子在他身后打了个响鼻，口中不急不慢的吃着草，贺堪对着对面同样收拾齐整的商队抱拳，道：“告辞。”
商队管事与身后的所有人都笑出了声。
起码因为逃过一劫，商队众人对于出手救了他们的贺堪都有不小的好感。
贺堪目送商队往南边走去，长长的队伍进入官道，贺堪知道，再往前不久，官道就会没了，商队就要走进仅是他们自己商队知道的商道，长长的枯草遮挡住他们的背影，只能听见那些大牲畜们走路的脚步声。
直到商队最后一个人的背影消失在尽头，贺堪这才收回目光。
“好了，我们也该回去了。”
content_en:
: After the discussion, both people achieved their goals.
The caravan manager got some inside information and was satisfied.
He Kan got an agreement that the caravan would come to Xiaohe Village frequently in the future, and he was also satisfied. This way, the village would not have to be in such embarrassment.
The caravan steward and He Kan looked at each other and smiled, each having a tacit understanding.
Even after the attack by monsters just happened, the caravan had no intention of leaving. They just added a few more bonfires, more people on duty, and more people on night watch. He Kan understood why the caravan didn't leave. As the same saying goes, night is a world of monsters. If you set out to find a new camp, you will probably lose more, so it is better to stay where you are.
He Kan chose to stay up until midnight.
Have a good night's sleep.
It might be the breath left by the tree ghost eggs, or it might be that there is a communication method between the strange creatures that no one knows. In short, nothing happened that night.
the next day.
He Kan got up early.
Early in the morning, the caravan cook had prepared all the toiletries and boiled the hot water at just the right temperature. In the cool morning, such hot water made the whole body feel comfortable, not to mention the hot porridge and rice served by the caravan cook at the right time after washing.
He Kan felt more comfortable eating it.
Of course there is one more thing going on so early today.
He Kan was about to part with the caravan.
Xiaohe Village is to the west of Daqi City, and the caravan's next trade route is to the south. Not only is it different, the caravan will follow it, and it is likely that it will take a detour. This is the consensus reached as early as Daqi City. At the end of the official road, He Kan separated from the caravan.
Even though the caravan manager had some changes due to yesterday's strange attack, he did not propose to change the route. In this world, caution has been engraved in everyone's heart. You can't just do whatever you want, and more people's lives will be burdened.
It can only be said that the caravan is more willing to include Xiaohe Village in the trade route in the future.
That's enough.
He Kan was very quick to prepare to part ways.
He bought a total of almost 500 kilograms of grain, plus clothes and various supplies, which amounted to almost 600 kilograms. He Kan's calculation was very accurate. He could carry about 100 kilograms. To avoid the strange objects encountered on the road, he could only carry a small part, and the rest could be carried on a donkey cart.
Yes.
Consider the issue of food.
He Kan rented it at first, but he just realized that it would be better to spend money directly instead of renting it. He Kan spent money with the caravan to buy the donkey cart, which was very convenient for carrying food.
"Well, Sir, I'll take my leave now."
After everything was packed up in the morning, He Kan also packed up the donkey cart. The grain was piled high on top of the cart. At first, the caravan steward didn't want the money and said he was grateful for yesterday's help. However, He Kan felt that one size fits all and he just gave it to him.
He Kan was alone. The donkey snorted behind him and ate grass in a leisurely manner. He Kan cupped his fists at the caravan opposite, which was also neatly packed, and said, "Goodbye."
The caravan steward and everyone behind him laughed out loud.
At least because they escaped, everyone in the caravan had a good impression of He Kan who saved them.
He Kan watched the caravan go south, and the long queue entered the official road. He Kan knew that soon the official road would disappear, and the caravan would enter the trade road known only to their own caravan. The long withered grass blocked their backs, and they could only hear the footsteps of the big livestock.
It wasn't until the back of the last person in the caravan disappeared at the end that He Kan looked away.
"Okay, it's time for us to go back."
